faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.q1: Can I do everything from my phone?
faq.a1: Yes! Robi is designed to work entirely from your smartphone. Create quotes, get them signed on the spot, and convert them to invoices in seconds. Everything runs right in your phone's browser — no app to download.
faq.q2: Can I know if my client opened my quote?
faq.a2: Yes. When you send a quote for remote signature, Robi shows you how many times the client opened it and the time of each view. Perfect for following up at the right moment!
faq.q3: Can I customize my invoices and quotes?
faq.a3: Absolutely. Add your logo, colors, choose from several professional templates, and include up to 5 photos in your quotes (job site, materials, etc.).
faq.a4: Yes. From your phone or computer, you can fill in your VAT certificates in a few clicks, then have your clients sign them electronically.
faq.a5: Yes, a real team answers your questions within 24 hours. No chatbots — real humans who understand your freelance challenges.
faq.q6: Can I manage multiple companies from the same account?
faq.a6: Yes. Robi lets you manage as many companies as you need from a single account. Switch between businesses in one click.
faq.q7: I'm a sole trader. Does the VAT exemption notice appear automatically?
faq.a7: Yes. When you set VAT to 0% on a quote or invoice, the VAT exemption notice appears automatically on the document.
faq.q8: How long does it take to create my first invoice?
faq.a8: Less than 30 seconds. Just tell Robi what you want to invoice — it generates the document instantly. All you have to do is approve and send.
faq.q9: Are my invoices compliant with legal requirements?
faq.a9: Yes. Every invoice generated by Robi includes all mandatory details: sequential numbering, VAT, company registration number, issue date, and payment terms. You're fully compliant.
faq.a10: You can cancel with one click, no commitment. Your data remains accessible in read-only mode for 12 months.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy policy and personal data protection at Robi AI.
privacy.introContent:
This policy explains how Robi AI (robi-app.com and go.robi-app.com) collects and uses your personal data.

**Data controller**: Late Night Studio (a company being incorporated) — contact: support@robi-app.com.
privacy.dataCollectedContent:
We collect:

- **Account**: first and last name, email address, sign-in method (email, Google, Apple)
- **Business**: company name, company and VAT numbers, address, country, logo
- **Invoicing**: your clients, products, quotes, invoices, payments, reminders
- **Robi AI assistant**: written or dictated requests (transcribed text) and the assistant's answers; receipt photos if you use the Expenses module
- **Usage and technical**: IP address, device, browser, pages viewed, actions in the app, origin (link or campaign you came from)
- **Payment**: handled by Polar (your Robi purchases) and Stripe (your own clients' payments); we store no card data

Dictation uses the speech recognition of your browser or phone (Google or Apple): the recording is processed by that provider, Robi AI only receives the text.
privacy.purposeContent:
Your data is used to:
- Provide the service: accounts, documents, sending, signature, reminders, Robi AI assistant
- Manage your purchases and subscriptions
- Send you service emails (address confirmation, getting started in the days after sign-up, security)
- Send you tips and offers, **only if you agreed** at sign-up
- Measure audience, improve the product and fix errors
- Measure the effectiveness of our ads, **only with your consent**
- Handle support and meet our legal obligations
privacy.legalBasisContent:
Our processing relies on:
- **Performance of the contract**: providing the service, purchases, service emails
- **Consent**: marketing emails, cookies and ad measurement (Meta, Google Analytics); you can withdraw it at any time
- **Legitimate interest**: audience measurement, security, product improvement, getting-started emails
- **Legal obligations**: keeping invoices and accounting records
privacy.retentionContent:
- **Account and documents**: while the account is active, then erased within 30 days of its deletion
- **Issued invoices**: as the issuer, you must keep them for 10 years; export them before deleting your account
- **Usage and measurement data**: 13 months maximum
- **Cookies**: 13 months maximum, consent asked again afterwards
- **Support**: as long as needed to handle the request, then 3 years maximum
privacy.rightsContent:
Under the GDPR, you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection and restriction, the right to withdraw your consent at any time, and the right to set instructions on what happens to your data after your death.

Every marketing email contains an unsubscribe link. To exercise your other rights: support@robi-app.com. You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr) or your local data protection authority.
privacy.securityContent:
We apply appropriate technical and organizational measures:
- Encryption of data in transit and at rest
- Hosting in the European Union
- Access to data limited to what is strictly necessary
- Security rules preventing one account from accessing another's data
privacy.subprocessorsContent:
Robi AI uses the following providers, each for a specific purpose:

- **Google Cloud / Firebase**: accounts, database, files, server functions (Belgium, europe-west1)
- **Google Gemini**: artificial intelligence of the Robi AI assistant and receipt reading
- **Vercel**: hosting of the site and app (Paris)
- **Supabase**: assistant conversation history and reminders
- **Pinecone**: search in your documents for the assistant
- **Polar**: processing of your Robi purchases (Merchant of Record)
- **Stripe**: your own clients' payments, if you enable it
- **Hostinger**: sending emails
- **Brevo**: B2B prospecting emails (unsubscribe at any time)
- **PostHog**: audience measurement and usage analytics, hosted in the European Union
- **Meta Platforms**: WhatsApp agent if you enable it (number and messages exchanged with Robi); measurement of our Facebook and Instagram ads, **only after your marketing consent** — pixel on robi-app.com and go.robi-app.com, and confirmation of sign-ups and purchases (hashed email address, amount)
- **Google Analytics**: audience measurement of robi-app.com, only after your consent

These providers act on our instructions and are bound by confidentiality. Some processing involves a transfer outside the European Union (notably artificial intelligence and document search), covered by appropriate safeguards (standard contractual clauses or the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, GDPR articles 44 to 49).
privacy.cookiesContent:
We use:
- **Essential cookies**: running the site, sign-in, remembering your choices (language, consent) — no prior consent needed
- **Audience measurement**: understanding how the service is used (PostHog, Google Analytics on the site)
- **Marketing cookies**: measuring our ads (Meta pixel), **only if you accept them**

You can change your choices at any time with the « Manage cookies » link at the bottom of the page; refusing does not prevent you from using Robi AI.
privacy.contactContent:
For any question about this policy or your data: support@robi-app.com.

Data controller: Late Night Studio (a company being incorporated).

You can also lodge a complaint with the CNIL: www.cnil.fr

cgv.title: Terms of Sale
cgv.description: Terms of sale of the Robi AI service, published by Late Night Studio.
cgv.objectContent:
These Terms of Sale govern the purchase of paid plans of the Robi AI invoicing service (robi-app.com and go.robi-app.com), published by Late Night Studio, a company being incorporated (contact: support@robi-app.com).

They apply to all users, business or consumer. Provisions specific to consumers (withdrawal, legal guarantee of conformity, mediation) only apply to people acting outside their professional activity.

Any purchase implies acceptance of these Terms, in the version in force on the day of purchase.
cgv.offersContent:
Robi AI offers the following plans:

- **Free version**: 4 invoices or quotes a month, no commitment and no card required
- **Pro Monthly**: €14 a month, unlimited access
- **Pro Annual**: €89 a year, unlimited access
- **Pro 2 years**: €149 for two years, unlimited access
- **Lifetime access (launch offer)**: €59, one-time payment

**Lifetime access**
It gives access to the Pro plan features, with no subscription or recurring payment, for as long as the Robi AI service is operated. It is offered during the launch period, within the limit of the spots and until the date shown in real time on the site (current deadline: October 31, 2026 at 11:59 pm, Paris time). The price paid is final for the buyer.

**Prices**
Prices are shown in euros for the eurozone; prices applicable to your country are shown on the Pricing page. Any VAT due depending on your country and status is calculated and displayed before payment. Robi AI may change its prices: a change never applies to a period already paid, and an ongoing subscription is only affected at renewal, with at least 30 days' prior notice.
cgv.paymentContent:
Purchases are processed by **Polar** (polar.sh), acting as Merchant of Record: Polar is the seller of the payment transaction, issues the purchase invoice and collects the applicable VAT. Payment is made by card on Polar's secure checkout page; Robi AI never has access to your card details.

Subscriptions (Pro Monthly, Annual, 2 years) are paid in advance and renewed automatically at each term until cancelled. Lifetime access is a one-time payment, with no renewal.

Paid features are activated as soon as payment is confirmed.
cgv.withdrawalContent:
If you are a consumer, you have **14 days** from purchase to withdraw, without giving a reason or paying a penalty (articles L.221-18 et seq. of the French Consumer Code). Robi AI applies this period to all its plans, lifetime access included, even if you have started using the service.

To withdraw, write to support@robi-app.com with the email address of your account. You will be refunded within 14 days of your request, by the same payment method, through Polar.
cgv.durationContent:
Subscriptions have **no commitment** beyond the period already paid.

- **Cancellation**: at any time, in the app (Settings › My subscription › « Gérer ou résilier mon abonnement », which opens the Polar customer portal), from the link in your purchase confirmation email, or by simple email to support@robi-app.com
- **Effect**: Pro access stays active until the end of the period already paid, then the account returns to the free version, with no further charge
- **Lifetime access**: no cancellation needed, no further charge

After cancellation, your invoices and quotes remain accessible in your account: only creating beyond the free limit is restricted. You can delete your account and data at any time from the app settings, subject to the legal retention periods for invoices.
cgv.ipContent:
Documents (invoices, quotes, certificates) created by the user with Robi AI **belong entirely to the user**. Robi AI claims no rights over this content.

The Robi AI service, its source code, design, trademarks and logos remain the exclusive property of Late Night Studio (a company being incorporated). Purchasing a plan grants a personal, non-transferable right to use the service.
cgv.liabilityContent:
Robi AI is an **invoicing assistance tool**. The user remains responsible for the information they enter or dictate, the content of their documents and sending them to their clients; they should review each document before issuing it.

Robi AI cannot be held liable for errors or omissions in the information provided by the user, nor for indirect damages (loss of revenue, customers or data), to the extent permitted by law.

**Legal guarantee of conformity (consumers)**
If you are a consumer, you benefit from the legal guarantee of conformity for digital content and services (articles L.224-25-12 et seq. of the French Consumer Code): in case of non-conformity, you can have the service brought into conformity, or failing that obtain a price reduction or terminate the contract. Contact: support@robi-app.com.
cgv.dataContent:
Personal data is processed in accordance with the GDPR, as detailed in our **Privacy Policy**. In short, it is:
- **Hosted in the European Union** (Belgium for the database, Paris for the app); some processing, such as artificial intelligence, involves transfers outside the EU covered by appropriate safeguards
- **Encrypted** in transit and at rest
- **Never sold**, and shared only with the providers needed to run the service, listed in the Privacy Policy
cgv.lawContent:
These Terms are governed by **French law**.

In case of dispute, first write to support@robi-app.com to seek an amicable solution.

**Mediation (consumers)**
If you are a consumer and your written complaint has not been resolved, you can use a consumer mediator free of charge (article L.612-1 of the French Consumer Code). The contact details of the designated mediator will be published on this page.

Failing agreement, the courts of Paris have jurisdiction for disputes between businesses; a consumer may bring the matter before the court of their place of residence.

cguMobile.dataContent:

cguMobile.liabilityContent:

cguMobile.terminationContent:
Uninstalling the app deletes neither the account nor the data.

To permanently delete your account: from the app settings, or by writing to support@robi-app.com; data is erased within 30 days, except where the law requires it to be kept.

cguMobile.lawContent: These Terms are governed by **French law**. In case of dispute, first write to support@robi-app.com. Failing agreement, the courts of Paris have jurisdiction for disputes between businesses; a consumer may bring the matter before the court of their place of residence.

deleteAccount.title: Delete my Robi account
deleteAccount.description: How to delete your Robi AI account and your data.
deleteAccount.inAppContent:
Deletion happens directly in the Robi AI app (iOS, Android or web):

1. Open **Settings**
2. Go to the **Account** tab
3. Choose **Delete my account** and confirm

Deletion is immediate: you are signed out and the account can no longer be accessed.
deleteAccount.byEmailContent: If you no longer have access to the app, write to **support@robi-app.com** from your account's email address with the subject "Account deletion". We process the request within 30 days and confirm by email.
deleteAccount.deletedContent:
- Your account and sign-in identities (email, Google, Apple)
- Your company settings, logo and preferences
- Your clients, products and drafts
- Your expense reports and receipts
- Your conversation history with the assistant
deleteAccount.keptContent: Issued invoices are accounting records: French law requires keeping them for **10 years** (Commercial Code, article L123-22). They are archived outside your account, stripped of any sign-in identifier, and used only to meet that legal obligation. Payment data is held by Polar and Stripe under their own policies.
deleteAccount.delayContent: Account deletion: immediate. Technical backups: erased within 30 days. Legal invoice archives: 10 years.
